plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for AsterFusion switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan, power supply status, and interface traffic, for AsterNOS (enterprise PEN 56928).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the AsterFusion AsterNOS device control plane (cpuUtilization, a scalar GET with instance .0 under enterprise PEN 56928). The vendor exposes a DisplayString percentage which is parsed to a 0-100 numeric gauge. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the AsterFusion AsterNOS device (memUtilization, a scalar GET with instance .0 under enterprise PEN 56928). The vendor exposes a DisplayString percentage which is parsed to a 0-100 numeric gauge. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized routing/MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the higher of the AsterFusion AsterNOS CPU and switch chip temperature scalars (afTemperatureCPU and afTemperatureSwitch, scalar GETs with instance .0), parsed from DisplayString to degrees Celsius. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat, and can trigger thermal protection or hardware damage if left unaddressed.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the state of each fan on the AsterFusion AsterNOS device (fanStatus, DisplayString), normalized so that 1 = healthy (OK / Present) and 2 = any other status. A value greater than 1 indicates a fan fault that can lead to overheating.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the state of each power supply on the AsterFusion AsterNOS device (psuStatus, DisplayString), normalized so that 1 = healthy (OK / Present) and 2 = any other status. A value greater than 1 indicates a power supply problem or lost redundancy.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
